edits.label: add lang+copy
edits.find:
import { Regex, Hash, Type, Layers } from "@lucide/astro";
---

edits.label: translate fields
edits.find:
<CalculatorField id="regexPattern" label="Pattern" type="text" placeholder="\\d+" />

      <CalculatorField id="regexFlags" label="Flags" type="text" value="g" placeholder="g, i, m, s" />

      <CalculatorField id="regexText" label="Test Text" type="textarea" placeholder="Paste text to test against..." />
edits.replace:
<CalculatorField id="regexPattern" label={copy.pattern} type="text" placeholder="\\d+" />

      <CalculatorField id="regexFlags" label={copy.flags} type="text" value="g" placeholder="g, i, m, s" />

      <CalculatorField id="regexText" label={copy.testText} type="textarea" placeholder={copy.testTextPlaceholder} />

edits.label: actions
edits.replace: <CalculatorActions calculateId="testBtn" resetId="resetBtn" copyId="copyBtn" showCopy={true} calculateText={copy.test} resetText={copy.reset} copyText={copy.copy} />

edits.label: EmptyState
result cards + highlighted label
edits.find:
<ResultCard id="matchCountResult" title="Matches" icon={Hash} />
          <ResultCard id="firstMatchResult" title="First Match" icon={Type} />
          <ResultCard id="groupsResult" title="Capture Groups" icon={Layers} />
        </ResultsGrid>

        <div class="tool-field">
          <label class="tool-label">Highlighted Text</label>
edits.replace:
<ResultCard id="matchCountResult" title={copy.matches} icon={Hash} />
          <ResultCard id="firstMatchResult" title={copy.firstMatch} icon={Type} />
          <ResultCard id="groupsResult" title={copy.groups} icon={Layers} />
        </ResultsGrid>

        <div class="tool-field">
          <label class="tool-label">{copy.highlighted}</label>

edits.label: about
edits.find:
About this Tool

Test JavaScript regular expressions against sample text with live match highlighting, flags support and capture group detection.

edits.label: wire calcLang
edits.replace:
<script define:vars={{ calcLang: lang }}>
  window.calcLang = calcLang;
</script>
<script>
  import "../../scripts/regex-tester";
</script>

edits.label: translate validate
translate summary
add lang
translate invalid pattern fallback
edits.replace: showError(result.error || (lang === "es" ? "Patrón de expresión regular inválido." : "Invalid regex pattern."));
